note: Phase 2 rule migration: enforcement target is the canonical spine (API -> Pipeline -> GatewayV3 -> Market Intelligence -> Decision), not the historical graph. Non-blocking until Phase 4. Engines consuming this file must skip unknown rule types with a warning, never crash.

rules.why: Constitution 7.2 / 11.7: dependencies point downward only; intelligence never imports delivery or runtime layers. Replaces NO_RUNTIME_IMPORT_IN_CORE and NO_CROSS_MARKET_INTELLIGENCE_TO_RUNTIME with one direction invariant. Scope excludes core.pipeline so the canonical facade may wrap the pipeline.

CHECK-001/002/003: api/pipeline/search_pipeline.py is the single production pipeline and the only caller of build_gateway_v3; the canonical market_intelligence modules are wired in. Constitution 3, 4, 11.1, 11.2.

CHECK-004, Constitution 8.1: no new imports into legacy. Covers legacy gateways (IntelligenceGateway contour), old MarketService, old pipelines, old ranking/risk/dedup/decision contours. Deny entries persist as tombstones after deletion batches. Deliberately NOT denied: dedup.dedup_index (canonical internal), engines.risk_engine / engines.dedup_engine (canonical; note engines.risk EngineV3 variant is removed via Deletion Manifest batch B, not by prefix rule, to avoid colliding with engines.risk_engine).
CHECK-005, Constitution 11.4: UnifiedRankingEngine is the only external ranking authority; MarketRankingEngine is reachable only from inside the ranking package or via the pipeline.
CHECK-006, Constitution 6.3 / 11.5: RiskEngine participates in the pipeline and DecisionLayer consumes the risk verdict; the veto is binding and may not be bypassed, sampled, or made advisory.
Constitution 11.6: delivery and presentation layers (api routes, bot, telegram) never import intelligence engines directly; the only entry is the pipeline.

removed.NO_API_TO_CORE_BACKFLOW: False violation: the canonical pipeline (api/pipeline/search_pipeline.py) legitimately imports core.market_intelligence — that import path IS the spine (Constitution 3). ADR section 2.
